en.headline: Retail sales rise 4.6% in June for 14th consecutive month
en.dek: The value of total retail sales reached HK$31.5 billion in June, with online sales up 11.6% and jewellery and watches jumping more than 20%, the Census and Statistics Department said.
body: Hong Kong’s retail sales continued their growth streak in June, rising 4.6% year-on-year in value to a provisional HK$31.5 billion, the Census and Statistics Department announced on Tuesday. It marked the 14th consecutive month of increase.

After adjusting for price changes, the volume of total retail sales grew 2.3% compared with June 2025. Online sales accounted for 9.4% of the total and climbed 11.6% to HK$3.0 billion. Sales of jewellery, watches and clocks, and valuable gifts surged 20.1%, while electrical goods and other consumer durables rose 11.3%.

For the first half of 2026, the value of total retail sales was provisionally estimated to have increased 9.6% from a year earlier, with volume up 7.2%. A government spokesman said the sector remains on a positive trajectory, supported by continued economic expansion, rising local incomes and a steady increase in inbound visitors, though external uncertainties pose downside risks.

zh.headline: 6月零售銷售額按年升4.6% 連續14個月增長
zh.dek: 政府統計處公布，6月零售業總銷貨價值暫定為315億元，按年升4.6%，網上銷售升11.6%，珠寶首飾、鐘錶及名貴禮物銷售升逾兩成。
body: 政府統計處周二公布，6月零售業總銷貨價值暫定為315億元，按年上升4.6%，連續第14個月錄得增長。
扣除價格變動後，零售業總銷貨量按年升2.3%。網上零售銷售佔總額9.4%，按年升11.6%至30億元。珠寶首飾、鐘錶及名貴禮物銷售價值急升20.1%，電器及耐用消費品則升11.3%。
2026年上半年，零售業總銷貨價值暫定按年升9.6%，銷貨量升7.2%。政府發言人表示，零售業仍處於正面軌跡，經濟增長、本地收入上升及訪港旅客穩步增加將繼續提供支持，惟外圍不確定性構成下行風險。
